messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: REQ-21 debrief: Samantha Lopez (Sr. Infra) — recommendation and routing

Team — attaching the interview eval matrix for REQ-21 (Samantha Lopez). Quick summary: strong system design, excellent infra domain knowledge, great culture fit. Concerns called out by the loops: comp expectations (~$320k total comp) exceed our current Sr Infra band midpoint by ~18%. Rohan asked for feedback on whether we should: 1) extend a stretch offer + escalate to VP/CFO approval, 2) re-scope to an IC (level down) and re-interview, or 3) close req and reallocate the headcount.

My read: candidate is high quality but external comp and our 2026 hiring freeze/band constraints make an exception risky. Recommendations: close and "redispatch" headcount now (reassign to Platform Observability), mark candidate as strong for future reopening, and offer a targeted pipeline note to Rohan for re-req if he secures additional budget.

Please reply with quick reactions — prefer a firm decision by EOD Monday so we can update candidate and Greenhouse. Attachment: req21-eval-matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

+1 to Marissa's recommendation. Band compression and hiring freeze are real — I'm reluctant to approve a band exception unless Rohan can point to an existing signed budget or a priority shift that frees up funds. If we keep the req open for escalation, we should define exact approvers and a formal approval deadline.

If we close, let's add a short note to the hiring plan about why headcount moved (priority: Platform Observability). Also: did the candidate indicate willingness to accept an IC-level role at lower comp? If yes, we might re-run a subset of loopers.

Laura
VP, Engineering Recruiting

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: REQ-21 debrief: Samantha Lopez (Sr. Infra) — compensation band note

Marissa / Team — reviewed comp implications. Our published Sr Infra band for 2026: target total comp range $220k–$260k, stretch to $280k only with VP + Finance (CFO) sign-off and an identified business justification (net new revenue/product critical). Candidate's ask at ~$320k is ~40% over midpoint and ~15% over stretch max. Approving that would require a formal band exception routed to VP Eng (L. Gomez) and CFO (M. Alvarez). Given the current hiring freeze language, approvals above band are being denied unless tied to critical revenue ops.

I've attached the comp-band-extract-2026.pdf for reference. If Rohan believes this is mission-critical, we need: 1) a written business case (1 page), 2) VP+Finance approval in writing, and 3) a commitment to close within 48 hours of approval.

If none of the above is present, HR recommends closing the req and marking the candidate as "declined due to comp alignment." We can also offer to keep Samantha warm for 6 months.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Compensation & People Ops

Marissa / team — I pushed hard on the hiring loop and believe Samantha is worth making an exception for. She has two rare skills (low-latency cache shard design + live DB failover experience) that directly unblock our Q3 roadmap for multi-region KV rollout. If we cannot stretch to her ask, I'd accept hiring her at a Senior level (one band down) at ~$275k total comp with a 6-month performance review and a structured comp revisit contingent on delivery.

If we go the exception route, I'll draft the 1-page business case and ping L. Gomez + M. Alvarez today. Rohan asks for permission to pursue that path — I need green to have those conversations before EOD Monday. Also linking the candidate feedback doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Req21-debrief
